item.title: Framework Raises DDR5 Memory Prices by 50% for DIY Laptops
item.description:
📝 25 Comments Framework Computer had worked to keep their memory prices lower than other laptop vendors amid the ongoing memory shortages throughput the industry worldwide. Due to the ongoing price hikes around system memory with shortages throughout the supply chain, Framework raised their DDR5 memory options today by 50% for the Framework Laptop DIY Edition. More details on Framework Computer needing to begin raising system memory prices can be found via the Framework Blog.
🔗 Read more: https://www.phoronix.com/news/Framework-50p-DDR5-Memory

item.title: Id Software devs form "wall-to-wall" union
item.description:
📝 "The wall-to-wall organizing effort at id Software was much needed; it’s incredibly important that developers across the industry unite to push back on all the unilateral workplace changes that are being handed down from industry executives," said id Software producer and CWA organising committee member Andrew Willis. CWA president Ron Swaggerty added that the union "look forward to sitting across the table from Microsoft to negotiate a contract that reflects the skill, creativity, and dedication these workers bring to every project. Solidarity to these id Software workers.
🔗 Read more: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/id-software-devs-form-wall-to-wall-union-with-165-workers-at-doom-studio-the-latest-to-vote-in-favour

item.description:
